classification: independent typed persistent harness program proposals; offline development applicability only
stop: first legal nonzero-applicability candidate, explicit abstention, two rejected generations, or any service failure; unused allowance canceled, no retry; no accepted update
instruction: Propose one persistent shared spatial-constraint program for a frozen LingBot-VLA harness, or abstain with empty rules. This is an independent NEW action space, not the closed gripper-command patch: no gripper closure, prefix edits or prompt edits. Use all ten attached DEVELOPMENT cases and first/middle/last observations; no validation records are present. The same program will be reused across task episodes. The only qualified spatial bindings for this first subspace are freshly MEASURED left_eef and right_eef XYZ in the same world frame, in meters. landmarks must be []. Rules compare predicted subject-minus-reference XYZ along x/y/z, or predicted Euclidean separation for distance. at_least/at_most/equal apply a squared hinge with tolerance_m. A rule is active only when CURRENT measured subject-reference distance <= activation_distance_m. Multiple active rules sum. Candidate variables are limited by the schema; no task-specific branches, hidden object poses, scorer queries or arbitrary code. The program gently steers predicted physical XYZ via a fixed common adapter; orientations/gripper values are not directly changed by its injected gradient, but later model predictions may couple channels. It cannot assert contact or object grasp, hold a gripper, select a subtask or change VLA language. Native gripper observations in the evidence are command targets, NOT measured openings or contact. Do NOT assume that two close end effectors imply a handover. Choose a non-vacuous, reusable constraint only if the evidence supports a plausible benefit and acknowledge its limitation in rationale. No guarantee a candidate will improve. Generic motion toward the other hand may harm stacking. Do not invent an object location from robot-state numbers. If this limited measured-state space cannot express a justified improvement, explicitly abstain; this will trigger another harness route, not extra calls. Submit only via submit_program. A legal candidate will undergo a deterministic offline nonzero-gradient check on all186 original development predictions, then a separately frozen paired task pilot; offline activity is not task success.
limits: No parameter updates, no new VLA or simulator execution; proposal storage is unaccepted. Part of route-A planned8proposal ceiling: allocates2 new calls; remaining6 remain unfrozen, not automatically runnable.
